subject: Decision window resync: action required on aging SF opportunities
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision window resync: action required on aging SF opportunities

Team —

Quick nudge ahead of end-of-month: finance asked me to confirm status on deals flagged as "aging / unverified" in our close-window report. I pulled a short list (attached) of 12 opportunities >60 days since last activity that are currently in Commit or Commit-ish stages. For forecast accuracy we need one of the following by EOD Monday (7/2):

- Owner confirms updated close date and the evidence (Doc/PO/DocuSign link)
- Owner pushes deal to Holdlist and marks reason
- Owner archives / moves to Nurture if not salvageable

I highlighted MDX-4621 (Medivex) — it shows as Negotiation but no close-date change since April and finance wants a call on whether to keep it in the commit. Attaching the stale-opps-summary-20280629.csv with our flags.

Please review your rows and reply with one-line decisions so I can consolidate and send a simple ask to finance. If you expect procurement/Legal to finish but need extra time, include a target date and link to evidence.

Thanks — small, fast replies please.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision window resync: action required on aging SF opportunities

Rishi —

Thanks for the summary. A quick clarification: for the opportunities flagged "Needs confirmation / stale", do you want us to update Close Date in SFDC today even if procurement has said "late June" but only gave a tentative 7/10 sign-off? Or should we move those to Holdlist with a target follow-up date?

Happy to adjust the Medivex row if you let me know preferred handling.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 13:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision window resync: action required on aging SF opportunities

Rishi / Lauren —

Quick update on Medivex (MDX-4621): procurement confirmed they have the final SOW and pricing approved; Legal has one minor redline in paragraph 4.3 and is expected to return signed copies after DocuSign review. Procurement told me today they expect signatures between 7/10–7/15, with a best-case of 7/10 if DocuSign routing completes without additional edits.

Request: please move Medivex to Stage = "Contract" and set Close Date = 2028-07-15 (target). I will upload the SOW and the DocuSign link to the deal record now (adding the DocuSign URL and a PDF stub). If DocuSign completes by 2028-07-10 I will update the close date to 2028-07-10 and flag for finance.

Attachments: medivex-sow.pdf (stub)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/medivex/MDX-4621

If you want us to keep it in Commit we can — but please apply the target close date so forecasting reflects a realistic window. If finance prefers only deals with signed docs in Commit, move to Holdlist and we will escalate.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision window resync: action required on aging SF opportunities

Thanks Monica — good, clear path.

Decision: update MDX-4621 to Stage = Contract and Close Date = 2028-07-15 (target). Keep the deal in Commit for this week on the condition that a signed DocuSign arrives by 2028-07-10; if not signed by 7/10 move to Holdlist with reason "procurement delay" and tag Finance. Lauren, can you apply the stage/close-date change in SFDC (I added the HubSpot/Deal link in the CSV) and drop the medivex-docusign-link.txt in the attachments field of the deal?

I will consolidate final statuses across the CSV on Monday and send a short note to Finance with the decisions (keeps vs holdlist vs archive). If anyone needs me to push on procurement/legal, ping me and I will escalate.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: medivex-docusign-link.txt (stub: https://app.docusign.com/medivex/MDX-4621)
